title: The Eraser Is Coming
altTitles: A Giant Eraser Is Deleting Their World
description: Something is erasing the page. Brick has to carry Bolt to the edge... and then stop running. #stickfigure #animation #shorts
topic: INK-06 heart/horror-lite (Brick lead, with Bolt): a real eraser wipes the page; lore: heavy lines can't be erased

snippets.STYLE: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading.
snippets.LOCK: Faces are two glowing eye-dots only: no mouth, no nose, no teeth, no brows, no smile. Each figure is one separate distinct body that never merges or fuses with another figure or object. Arms end in simple rounded tips with at most three rounded nubs, never realistic human hands. Every figure keeps its signature accessories in every frame. Consistent glossy 3D render throughout, never flat 2D. Every surface is blank and unmarked, with no readable text or letters; any sign shows a simple icon only.
snippets.BOLT: BOLT: an average-height black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, electric cyan (#22D3EE) glowing eyes and rim light, a long flowing cyan scarf that trails light when moving
snippets.BRICK: BRICK: a large black ink stick figure with thick heavy limbs (three times normal thickness) and a round glossy head, lime green (#7CFF4F) glowing eyes and rim light, a lime visor band across the eyes
snippets.NEG: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, readable signs, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, eyebrows, smiles, human faces, skin, hair, realistic human hands, five-finger hands, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fused or merged bodies, flat 2D cartoon look, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds.
snippets.KF: stick figure, NOT a human, no face, no skin, no clothing except listed accessory. Deep focus, sharp to the frame edges, full-frame image with no borders or letterbox bands. Vertical 9:16 frame.
snippets.TINK: a single glossy ink drip falling and landing, followed by one bright crisp glass tink, clean and close
snippets.ERASER: THE ERASER: a giant real pink rubber pencil eraser, a physical macro-photographed object taller than a house, soft matte rubber with fine grain, slightly rounded worn edges and pink-grey rubber crumbs, lit like a macro product shot; an inanimate object with no face, no eyes, no mouth and no limbs, NOT a creature, NOT a character; its blank sides carry no printing, logo or letters.
snippets.PAPER: a vast sheet of real cream drawing paper stretching to the horizon like a landscape, visible paper fibre, gentle folds rising into soft hills, dotted with glossy 3D black-ink drawn landmarks (ink-line trees, a lighthouse, an arched bridge, a windmill), warm late-afternoon sun, volumetric haze
snippets.BLANK: The erased strip behind the eraser is real blank white paper with visible fibre, soft 3D shading and scattered grey rubber crumbs, never a flat white void.
snippets.WIND: open wind across a vast paper field, soft paper rustle, seamless
snippets.SCRUB: a giant rubber eraser scrubbing across paper: deep rubbery squeak, paper friction and crumbling rubber, heavy and relentless

qc: INK-06: The Eraser is a real macro-lit pink rubber eraser OBJECT: any face, eyes, mouth, limbs or creature read = reject; no printing or letters on its sides. Erased paper stays real paper (fibre, 3D shading, crumbs), never a flat white void. Drift: Bolt keeps his cyan scarf in every shot (incl. when carried); Brick keeps his lime visor and limbs visibly three times thicker than Bolt's. Rim cues: Brick dims S1/S4/S8, steady S6, brightens S9, flares S11; Bolt dims S5, returns S11. Limbs: S6 carry and S9 brace are the fused-body risks; Bolt and Brick must read as two separate bodies, arms end in rounded tips, no human hands. S9 is CS4 with refs [1 Bolt, 2 Brick] (subset, tokens renumbered): check 9:16 and that the eraser stays an object. Labels lower-third only, never over faces. Audio: wind bed + eraser scrub under every section plus music; drip-tink at 0 and on the lore line (S10). Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused/merged body ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, smile, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
